notes.title: Pongo Update: New Pricing + Soundtrack Streaming
notes.content:
Hello Pongo-masters! 

We have changed the price of the game to the meer $00.99! Now you can finally buy a copy for all of your friends! 

Many people are requesting for a way to buy/stream/download the soundtrack, so here you go!  Bandcamp Link (Free)	

If you have any suggestions, questions, comments, anything-- go to our  Website  or  Twitter !

notes.title: New Update Info + Some Announcements!
notes.content:
Hello, Pongo-ers!

Have you been anxiously waiting on the edge of your seat for the next Pongo update? Well, you will have to wait no further! Here is what has been added: 


Jam out to the NEW original soundtrack! Composed by Taylor Fredericks, Pongo now has a new groove with some fun island tunes. 

Immerse yourself in the world of Flubber using Intel® RealSense™! Drixy Studios has partenered with Intel to add RealSense™ compatability. 

Optimization!

Bug fixes! Keep pointing out any bugs you find in the community, we are anxious to fix them!


Announcement: Mac and Linux support is coming very soon within the next 10 days! Keep up to date on our Twitter for more updates regarding the OS compatibility update.

Announcement: Soundtrack DLC (Steam Music) coming soon! 

Announcement: Controller support coming soon! 

That is all for now- You can tweet to us for more suggestions at @DrixyStudios, or leave a constructive Steam review! 

Have a good day, and keep Pongoing!

-The Drixy Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 has been released!
notes.content:
New Stuff:
-Killing an enemy A.I. takes 3 seconds from the time counter/score.
-Added Achievement Stats(Deaths, Enemy Kills).

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some level selector bugs,
-Fixed the achievements bugs,
-Fixed the Continue Button loading the last level played bug, now the button loads the last level available.



Thank you everyone for your reports and for being part of the Pongo community.
